code:
Traditional firewall sees:
  src=laptop  dst=203.0.113.10  port=443  [ALLOW]

NGFW with DPI sees:
  src=laptop  dst=203.0.113.10  port=443
  payload pattern -> "Facebook"  [policy: BLOCK Facebook]
caption: Same port, same protocol — DPI tells the firewall what the traffic actually is.
